name: WdWrapSideType
description: Specifies whether the document text should wrap on both sides of the specified shape, on either the left or right side only, or on the side of the shape that is farthest from the page margin.

constants.name: wdWrapBoth
constants.description: Both sides of the specified shape.

constants.name: wdWrapLargest
constants.description: Side of the shape that is farthest from the page margin.
